arStrings.szText: Hitting a Lesser Demon with {c_important}Bombardment{/c} explodes it for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} of a {c_important}Bombardment{/c} impact if the Demon has less than {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} |4second:seconds; duration left. {c_important}Bombardment{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
